Cast in Shadow
Click 🎧 to listen.
Listen to a conversation between two students. The girl is discussing her opinion about how technology changes a play. Listen carefully. You will hear the conversation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions about the conversation and the evidence the girl gives to support her opinion. As you listen, you may take notes.
Listen to the Conversation
1QUESTION 1:
Why does the girl run the same scene two times, changing only the background?
2QUESTION 2:
Where did the girl learn how to create the shadow look?
3QUESTION 3:
What did most classmates say about the character in the shadow version?
4QUESTION 4:
What does the girl conclude from her test?
Answer all 4 questions to submit.
Choose the best answer for each question. You may change your answers before submitting.
SMART SUPPORT:
Go back to the conversation. Identify why the girl changed only the background between her two versions. Identify where she learned the shadow look. Identify what most classmates felt in the shadow version. Identify her main point about what the technology changed.
